mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sku_stock (sku_id,sku_code, warehouse_id, physical_stock, version) VALUES (#{skuId},#{skuCode}, #{warehouseId}, #{quantity}, 1) ON CONFLICT (sku_id, warehouse_id) DO UPDATE SET physical_stock = sku_stock.physical_stock + EXCLUDED.physical_stock, version = sku_stock.version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;
mapper.update: UPDATE sku_stock SET reserved_stock = reserved_stock + #{quantity}, version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE sku_id = #{skuId} AND warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND physical_stock >= (reserved_stock + #{quantity})
